facts.fact: Adwave says TV, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram can all run from a $30 daily budget.
facts.quote: With Adwave, TV, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram can all run from a $30 daily budget.

facts.fact: The page cites a commonly cited national average for hearing aids of $2,000 to $7,000 per pair, depending on features and services (a third-party figure, not an Adwave number).
facts.quote: The commonly cited national average for hearing aids is $2,000 to $7,000 per pair, depending on features and services included.

facts.fact: Adwave lists Reddit placements from about $35 per day.
Adwave lists optional TikTok placements from about $91 per day, opt-in only.
Adwave's published pricing sets daily budgets from $30 to $10,000 with no subscription.
facts.quote: sets daily budgets from $30 to $10,000, with no subscription.

facts.fact: Extra Adwave creative beyond the included campaign creative is priced at $0.38 per image.
facts.quote: extra creation is priced separately: $0.38 per image, $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot, and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: At a $30 daily budget, the page's table shows $900 over 30 active days, with TV, Google Search, Facebook, Instagram, web and mobile eligible.
facts.quote: | $30 | $900 | TV, Google Search, Facebook, Instagram, web and mobile |

facts.fact: Adwave's planning example uses a $75 daily budget, which the page's table shows as $2,250 over 30 active days.
Pausing an Adwave campaign stops future daily charges, and the day's set-aside is settled the next morning.
facts.quote: Pausing stops future daily charges. Today’s set-aside is settled the next morning, so you pay only for what ran.

facts.fact: On Adwave, a new daily budget on a live campaign applies the same day if the wallet covers it, with no proration.
facts.quote: A new daily budget on a live campaign applies the same day if your wallet covers it, with no proration.

facts.fact: Adwave card deposits carry a processing fee shown at checkout, while ACH deposits carry none.
facts.quote: card deposits add a processing fee shown at checkout, while ACH deposits have none.

facts.fact: In 2020 the FTC sent a warning letter to two hearing aid sellers whose mailers falsely claimed a COVID-19 stimulus voucher of $1,000 toward two hearing aids.
facts.quote: falsely claimed a COVID-19 stimulus voucher of $1,000 toward two hearing aids

facts.fact: The FDA's 2022 final rule created an over-the-counter (OTC) hearing aid category alongside prescription hearing aids.
facts.quote: The FDA’s 2022 final rule created an OTC hearing aid category alongside prescription hearing aids

facts.fact: OTC hearing aids cannot be sold to people under 18 years old.
facts.quote: OTC hearing aids cannot be sold to people under 18

facts.fact: Prescription hearing aids may be sold only on the order of a licensed practitioner.
facts.quote: prescription hearing aids may be sold only on the order of a licensed practitioner

facts.fact: Google's healthcare and medicines policy treats some violations as egregious and suspends accounts without prior warning.
facts.quote: treats some violations as egregious and suspends accounts without prior warning

facts.fact: Meta's Health and Wellness ad standards prohibit certain health claims and set age-targeting limits for some health categories.
facts.quote: set age-targeting limits for some health categories
